visualReview.notes: Inspected all seven current portable frames against the individually inspected Qualla front, beach, aerial and rotunda photographs. The courtyard remains open, the main twelve-sided turret has two dormer tiers and a belvedere, and the wings retain verandas, smaller turrets and varied roofs. Corrected tower tiers, dormer projection, hidden courtyard windows and camera framing. Roof intersections and hidden elevations remain generalized.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Inspected all seven current shared-material frames. Painted wood siding and wooden trim replace the default masonry binding; red roofs and glass remain coherent in the viewer. The north-up footprint overlay, heading, material graph reads and unload pass. Mapped rear pavilion is deliberately excluded. Flat ground is a material and transform fixture; preserved terrain is assessed separately.

mediumFiReview.notes: Inspected all nineteen current lighting, quality, front/back, silhouette and forced detail-level frames. Final context scale keeps the entire turret and foundation visible. The courtyard, red roofs and tower remain recognizable at all four levels; fine railings and trim drop out with distance. Surrounding blocks are synthetic fixtures. No physical-device performance measurement is claimed.

fidelityReview.scope: Historic Victorian courtyard hotel, verandas and turrets; later north pavilion, separate resort neighborhoods, landscaping and interiors excluded.
fidelityReview.notes: Original medium-fi exterior follows four individually inspected local Qualla 2006–2019 photographs and the mapped open courtyard. Historical HABS description supports wooden siding, ocean-side four storeys, other five-storey wings, verandas and roof forms. Three smaller turrets, main twelve-sided roof, two dormer tiers, belvedere and flagpoles are retained. Fine carpentry, exact roof joints and unseen facade spacing are interpretations. Dated references do not establish every 2021–2025 restoration detail. Reference images are not embedded or redistributed.

runtimeLodReview.notes: All four current hash-bound detail levels pass strict geometry and draw budgets and were inspected. Skyline retains the courtyard, wings and main roofline; district adds facade rhythms and dormers, street adds railings, closeup adds fine trim and balusters. Error thresholds are authoring limits, not independently measured mesh distances.

geometryValidation.notes: Exact source regeneration, ordinary import verification, four current LOD checks and strict medium-fi audit passed. Source bundle, scene and terrain schemas pass; terrain PNG round-trip error is recorded above. No independent Khronos-validator run is claimed.

limitations: Original medium-fi historic hotel exterior derived from the mapped open courtyard and individually inspected Qualla 2006–2019 photographs; not an architectural survey.

White painted wood, red shingle roofs, verandas, dormers and twelve-sided ballroom tower are retained. Exact floor heights, roof intersections, hidden facade rhythm, ornament and stair joins are interpretations.
The later connected north service pavilion, separate modern resort neighborhoods, pool complex, utility buildings, landscaping and interiors are excluded.
This dated-reference exterior does not claim every 2021–2025 porch/courtyard restoration detail. Flagpoles are modeled without animated flags.
Independent ground is preserved. Other host terrain sources may differ. Reference images are not embedded or redistributed.
